about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Day” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered by the new Nativity of Thine Only-begotten Son, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
